definitions.gloss: demolition; teardown; pulling down a building
definitions.explanation: The act of deliberately destroying a building or structure in order to remove it. Commonly refers to planned demolition of old buildings to make way for new construction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{取|と}り{壊|こわ}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: The demolition of the old building has begun.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧{取|と}り{壊|こわ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: This house is scheduled for demolition next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歴史的|れきしてき}→歴史的：05671_rekishiteki⟧な⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{取|と}り{壊|こわ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}する→反対する：05648_hantaisuru⟧⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{署名|しょめい}→署名：03682_shomei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めている→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: Residents opposing the demolition of the historic building are collecting signatures.

notes:
The noun form of the compound verb ⟦{取|と}り{壊|こわ}す→取り壊す：15755_torikowasu⟧ (to tear down/demolish). Composed of ⟦{取|と}り→取る：00565_toru⟧ (taking) + ⟦{壊|こわ}し→壊す：01241_kowasu⟧ (breaking). Commonly used in real estate, urban planning, and construction contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {取|と}り{壊|こわ}し⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧: demolition work
- {取|と}り{壊|こわ}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まる→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧: demolition is decided
- {取|と}り{壊|こわ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to be slated for demolition
- {取|と}り{壊|こわ}し⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧: demolition costs
- ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{取|と}り{壊|こわ}し: demolition of a building

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{解体|かいたい}→解体：06223_kaitai⟧: dismantling — more technical/formal, also used for organizations
- ⟦{撤去|てっきょ}→撤去：14729_tekkyo⟧: removal — removing structures, signs, or obstacles
- ⟦{破壊|はかい}→破壊：13678_hakai⟧: destruction — violent or unplanned destruction, not just buildings
